## Why

The consumer keepalive evaluation can silently retain the default Codex route for `agent:auto`, even when other provider credentials exist: `evaluateKeepaliveLoop` reads five `HAS_*` environment flags, but its invoking step exports none of them. This was reported on a superseded generation of Portable-Alpha-Extension-Model#2276 and remains present in current Workflows main. The current Astra-only delivery changes three other files, so this source-owned follow-up preserves the finding separately.

## Scope

`templates/consumer-repo/.github/workflows/agents-81-gate-followups.yml`, the evaluation step invoking `.github/scripts/keepalive_loop.js`, and focused workflow contract tests.

## Non-Goals

Do NOT change consumer repos directly from this issue.

## Tasks

- [ ] Export credential-presence booleans for `HAS_CODEX_AUTH`, `HAS_CLAUDE_AUTH`, `HAS_CLAUDE_OAUTH`, `HAS_CURSOR_AUTH`, and `HAS_GEMINI_AUTH` in the evaluation step of `templates/consumer-repo/.github/workflows/agents-81-gate-followups.yml`, using existing preflight credential semantics without exposing secrets.
  - [ ] Document the exact environment variable export syntax needed for each credential flag in the evaluation step (verify: confirm completion in repo)
  - [ ] Identify the preflight step's credential detection logic that should be replicated in the evaluation step (verify: confirm completion in repo)
  - [ ] Create a test fixture that validates credential flags are exported without exposing secret values (verify: confirm completion in repo)
  - [ ] Prepare the workflow YAML changes as a patch file for manual application to the protected workflow (verify: confirm completion in repo)
- [ ] Add a contract test in `tests/workflows/test_workflow_agents_consolidation.py` that checks evaluation and preflight provide matching availability inputs, plus an auto-routing case with a non-Codex provider available.
  - [ ] Create a test function that verifies evaluation step exports match preflight step credential flags (verify: confirm completion in repo)
  - [ ] Implement a test case for auto-routing behavior when only non-Codex provider credentials are available (verify: confirm completion in repo)
  - [ ] Add a test that validates availability input consistency between evaluation (verify: confirm completion in repo)
  - [ ] preflight steps (verify: confirm completion in repo)
  - [ ] Write assertions to confirm the keepalive script receives all required HAS_* environment variables (verify: confirm completion in repo)
- [ ] Publish the source change in `.github/scripts/keepalive_loop.js` before delivering the updated workflow through Maint 68 consumer sync.
  - [ ] Review keepalive_loop.js to identify what changes are needed to properly consume the HAS_* environment variables (verify: confirm completion in repo)
  - [ ] Update keepalive_loop.js to handle cases where non-Codex providers are available but Codex is not (verify: confirm completion in repo)
  - [ ] Add error handling in keepalive_loop.js for missing credential environment variables (verify: confirm completion in repo)
  - [ ] Document the deployment sequence for coordinating script changes with workflow template updates (verify: confirm completion in repo)

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `python -m pytest tests/workflows/test_workflow_agents_consolidation.py -k keepalive -q` exits 0 including the new credential-export contract assertions.
- [ ] With only an available non-Codex provider, auto-routing selects an eligible provider instead of treating every provider as unavailable.
- [ ] Missing credentials still prevent selecting that provider; no secret values appear in logs.

## Implementation Notes

Current source inspected 2026-09-05: evaluation lines 294–297 export only input values and `ROUTE_WEIGHTS_URL`; preflight exports credential flags. Original review thread: https://github.com/stranske/Portable-Alpha-Extension-Model/pull/2276 (thread `PRRT_kwDOO15QxM6fd9vJ`, old generation `22edf0a89622d91e3d9ecf06d582d837f0d10950`).
